en: A vintage postcard featuring German text, postage mark, and address fields. The card includes 'Postkarte' at the top, indicating it is a postcard. It is addressed to B. Iwakidoff, in 'Ales del Berg,' with specific reference to 'Landhausstrasse, 14.' Two circular postmarks are visible, one from 'BAD MAUERN' dated 17.10.12, and another from 'Friedberger.' A stamp from the Austrian Empire is present in the upper right corner.
